notes: Exercise PinMAME's compile-time P2K_DEBUG ball model. Run only against a separately built PINMAME_P2K_DEBUG=ON DLL with P2K_TROUGH=4, P2K_BALLSAT=1200, P2K_DRAIN=60, P2K_LANEHOLD=20, and P2K_PLAYFIELD=1. The model owns the stock active-low trough optos and shooter-lane switch; this scenario supplies only cabinet actions and asserts the ROM's trough-eject and auto-plunger outputs. It validates logical state sequencing, not physical travel time, coil force, or launch vectors.
